answer: In a decentralized network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to a unique digital identity, tied to a proof-of-work based on a cryptographic puzzle. Each agent is assigned an "island" of neighboring nodes, with which it exchanges a unique "opal" token, infused with a pigment of trustworthiness. An attacker attempting to create multiple Sybil identities must expend computational resources to solve the puzzle for each fake identity, making it costly to create a large number of fake agents and thereby resistant to manipulation.
